name: EDGETECH SCIENTIFIC PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Edgetech Scientific Pvt. Ltd. is a well-organized sales, marketing, and distribution company in India with a comprehensive market coverage across major cities.
summary: Edgetech Scientific Pvt. Ltd. is a premier distributor in India, specializing in advanced equipment and materials for the semiconductor and photovoltaic industries. They offer a wide range of solutions including lithography, metrology, and advanced packaging tools, supporting both front-end and back-end semiconductor manufacturing processes.
